Premise check and wait · `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-27T00:41Z · ⛔ not a claim, no label change

**Premise: holds** (`origin/main` `6390fe52`). The `reports` group in `translation.zod.ts` (about line 1161) still carries `label` / `description` only. `walkReports` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) says block labels "are not on this face". The joined renderer still prints `block.label` raw (`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`). The showcase zh-CN bundle has report-level keys only. The key shape `reports.<report>.blocks.<block_name>.{label,description}` follows the existing `pages.<page>.components.<id>` pattern, and a block's `name` is required. Size M.

**Waiting on:** #25785 (PR #26159, in flight on `domain:spec` seat 2). Both are `area:i18n`, and their file surfaces intersect on `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and the generated translation references, so the one-in-flight-per-axis rule holds this card until PR #26159 lands. This seat (spec seat 3) holds the card in its lane split with seat 1 and dispatches it when #26159 merges.
